messages.author: b5f242e7eb90c7c9
messages.subject: About Bayesian SSP estimation
parts:
Dear all,

Recently, Lu, Chow, & Loken (2016; published in Multivariate Behavioral Research) has published a paper discussing a new Bayesian approach (BSEM approach with spike-and-slab prior, or BSEM-SSP). This is in contrast to Muthen and Asparouhov approach. They also showed the superiority of this new approach in a recent Psychological Methods paper. I wonder if anyone knows whether they are any available software to analyze data using this new BSEM-SSP approach?

Thanks for the information!

Best, Chester

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: About Bayesian SSP estimation
parts:
Chester,

I don't know of software that will immediately allow you to fit models with these priors. I have had some success implementing spike-and-slab priors in JAGS, but nothing has made it into blavaan.

Also, fwiw, I think the Stan group is not sold on spike-and-slab priors (and Stan does not directly handle discrete parameters). See the long thread surrounding this comment:

https://groups.google.com/d/msg/stan-users/mCcCg7cpW30/Fd3-PdhKAwAJ

Ed
